text: Leave ether standing in air and light for months, and it slowly takes up oxygen at the carbon next to the oxygen, forming a hydroperoxide. The peroxide does not evaporate. When the old ether is distilled, the ether boils away, the peroxide concentrates in the flask, and near dryness it explodes.
